posts.name: Christopher
posts.cooked:
I just posed an update about Exemplar, one of the main villains from Sentinel Tactics: Battle for Broken City.

In case you missed it, at the end, I noted my plans for tomorrow:

Tomorrow (Wednesday, the 25th of February) I will be tweeting Sentinel Comics trivia questions every hour on the hour starting at 10 AM CST. If I get a correct answer to a trivia question within 10 minutes, I post a story update. I will be doing so ever hour, with the last question posting at 5 PM CST. That's EIGHT possible updates, all about the story of the Villains of the Multiverse expansion! You don't want to miss this - tomorrow is going to be an intense day!

So! Keep an eye on my Twitter account tomorrow, as correct answers = more stories pretty much all day!

Whew, I've got my work cut out for me.
